overview: A quiet two-day window with three patch series. The most substantial work was Leon Hwang's v5 series adding syscall common attrs support for XDP link_create, improving consistency between BPF link types. A new bpf_ksock_bind() kfunc from Mahe Tardy rounds out the set.

patches.title: bpf: Add syscall common attrs support for link_create
patches.author: Leon Hwang
patches.summary: This v5 series (6 patches) extends the BPF link_create syscall to accept a common attrs structure, bringing XDP link creation in line with other link types. It adds syscall common attrs support for both generic link_create and the XDP-specific path, retires the now-redundant bpf_xdp_link_attach_failed tracepoint, and adds libbpf helpers (log_opts support and __sys_bpf_fd factoring) to expose the new functionality to userspace. Selftests verify that link_create log messages are captured correctly.

patches.title: bpf: Add bpf_ksock_bind() kfunc
patches.author: Mahe Tardy
patches.summary: Introduces the bpf_ksock_bind() kfunc, allowing BPF programs to bind a kernel socket to a local address directly from BPF context. This fills a gap for programs that manage kernel sockets and need to perform the full bind/connect lifecycle. A selftest verifying the new kfunc's behavior is included in patch 2/2.

patches.title: selftests/bpf: Enable signed division and modulo overflow tests for LoongArch
patches.author: Tiezhu Yang
patches.summary: Enables the BPF signed integer division and modulo overflow selftests on the LoongArch architecture, which previously skipped them. LoongArch now handles the INT_MIN/-1 overflow case consistently with other architectures, so the skip guard is removed to improve test coverage on that platform.
